title: finding(plugin-grid,security): on the host-fetched path an untyped view column over a `password` / `secret` field draws its raw value until the grid's object schema settles, and for good if that read fails
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a security defect with named sites (class a): a credential drawn in the clear. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the round-3 security review of PR objectui#10643 (objectui#10583) at `4d341308a`, which measured it. PR objectui#10643 states this window in its "Not covered" list and does not close it: the draw half predates that PR, and closing it is a design choice outside objectui#10583. ⛔ Not graded here.

## The window

`ObjectGrid` resolves a column's type, and so its cell renderer and every masked-field guard, from `objectSchema?.fields?.[key]?.type` when the view column authors no `type`. The console's ordinary view columns author none.

On the inline path, `objectSchema` starts `null`. This is the path every fetching host takes: `dataConfig.provider === 'value'`, with `ListView` handing its rows down as `data` and `ObjectView` doing the same through `list-view`.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:1919-1931` sets `data` from the host synchronously and ends `loading`.
- `:1937-1960` fetches the object schema afterwards (`dataSource.getObjectSchema(objectName)`, `:1946`).
- So the rows paint before the grid knows which fields are `password` / `secret`.

## Measured by the reviewer (probe at `4d341308a`; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

The setup: an object-declared `password` field `api_key`, an untyped view column, inline rows, and `getObjectSchema` held pending.
- Before the schema settled, the cell drew the raw value as text. With `grouping: { fields: [{ field: 'api_key' }] }`, the one group row's `.group-label` was the raw credential.
- After it settled, the mask drew and there were 0 group rows (PR objectui#10643's grouping refusal).
- PR objectui#10643's copy, tooltip, edit, export and card guards key on the same type, so they are open in the same window. That is unmeasured, but they read the same key.

## Worse than a window when the read fails (read by the seat at `origin/main` `1e946c96a`)

`:1950-1954` swallows a failed schema read: "Schema fetch failure for inline data is non-fatal; columns will still fall back to heuristic inference". So a failed or refused `getObjectSchema` leaves an untyped credential column drawn in the clear for the life of the grid.

## Reach

A schema cache miss is a network round trip: the first visit to an object in `data-objectstack`'s `MetadataCache`, or any adapter without a cache. The failure branch is reachable on any refused or failed metadata read. The server's own masking of the row payload is the other guard; this card is about the client drawing whatever the row carries.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Two shapes the review named, with different costs:
- the host hands the grid the object types it already holds (`ListView` has `objectSchema`), so there is no window;
- or an object-bound untyped column is withheld (drawn as unknown, not as text) until the schema settles, and stays withheld if the read fails.

The first changes a props seam between plugin-list and plugin-grid. The second changes first paint for every object-bound grid on a cache miss. Pins: the reviewer's held-schema probe (draw, group label), red on base and green on head, plus the failed-read arm.

## Dedupe

REST read of objectui issues and PRs (the 1000 most recent, plus every item updated since 2026-09-25T12:00Z), matched against `schema settles|objectSchema.{0,40}null|host-fetched|untyped view column` and `masked.{0,80}(first paint|before the schema)`. The 5 hits are lookup-label, test-harness and `ObjectGantt` cards (objectui#10487, PR objectui#10557, PR objectui#10513, objectui#7502, objectui#7232), none about a masked field. objectui#10657 (the other `data-table` producers set no `masked`, folding objectui#10658) is a different gap. Lit control: the same walk finds objectui#10487 for `objectSchema`.

Dedupe words: `masked column first paint schema window` · `inline data objectSchema null password raw` · `untyped view column credential drawn before schema`
